integrity.claim_scope: An exact count of failing centers and a matching construction under all four specified valuation conventions, plus a sharp capacity boundary.

scientific_limitations: Binary nonnegative additive valuations; two lower agents and two goods per center; exactly one good per lower agent.
No efficiency requirement and no claim of independent confirmation.
Capacity-three Hall counterexample prevents extension of the simple criterion.
title: A Hall-deficiency formula for binary delegated center-EFX
